_comment: STAGE-D per-batch coverage registry -- batch 'gksl_crowjoynt' of the full-coverage
program (docs/twin_validation/wave2_6_unit_test_contract.md SS12.3/12.4; work-list
docs/twin_validation/l3_release_package_unit_inventory.md). Run via
tests/harness/gate.py <this file> (L0+L1; calls tests/harness/coverage_audit.py) and
tests/harness/mutation.py <this file> (L2).
Covers the two shared-bath carrier PRIMITIVE modules (both CPU-pure numpy/scipy; NO
torch, NO quimb, NO cuda -- so everything is IN SCOPE; out_of_scope is empty):
* quantum_bath/gksl.py       -- boson_ops, build_shared_bath_liouvillian, round_superop
* quantum_bath/crow_joynt.py -- gamma_unit_closed, sigma_offdiag_closed, build_sigma,
field_null_dual_P_all, field_null_point
ZERO exemptions. Every unit reaches 100% statement + 100% branch over the tracked branch
surface with NO named exemption. Several units are straight-line or comprehension-only, so
coverage.py --branch tracks NO branch arc for them (0/0 -> 1.0, coverage.py's empty
convention): build_shared_bath_liouvillian, round_superop, gamma_unit_closed,
sigma_offdiag_closed, field_null_point are straight-line; field_null_dual_P_all's
P_all/P_skip dict-comprehensions score 0/0 (its for-loop arcs ARE tracked and covered).
boson_ops (for-loop, nmax>=2 body + nmax==1 empty) and build_sigma (r==s / r!=s ternary)
have REAL branch arcs, both covered with real inputs (no underflow/invalid-input branch was
found that a real input could not reach). _gamma_of_t is PRIVATE (leading underscore) and
therefore not a public unit -- it is exercised as the numerical cross-check of
gamma_unit_closed but carries no coverage target.
NB (review-lesson F1): both modules are CPU-pure -- gksl imports only math/numpy/scipy,
crow_joynt only math/numpy/scipy + sibling package modules -- so NOTHING can be parked as
gpu_bound/quimb_bound (the structural _module_imports guard would refute it). No
out_of_scope entries.
